top_signals.title: AMD to Raise as Much as $5 Billion From Debt Offering
top_signals.summary: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. is planning to raise as much $5 billion in what could be the chipmaker’s biggest-ever investment-grade bond sale, adding to a wave of debt tied to the artificial intelligence boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: South Korea sentences Delio CEO to 15 years in prison for $50 million crypto fraud: report
top_signals.summary: The sentence is shorter than the 20-year term that prosecutors sought, as the judge acquitted Jeong of a primary charge.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
